name: rotid-phase0-h1
purpose: Phase 0: address behaviour of advertising sets (relaunch and stack timer). S24 and M31 advertise a stream-ready set, ASUS and A15s scan.

results.question: Does a new advertising set (app relaunch) get a new address; does the stack rotate the address of a running set (timer)?
results.source: ASUS controller-level capture (controller view, extended advertising reports), app logs adv_set_churn on advertisers

S24.restart_new_address: 3 sets, 3 different RPAs (<addr>, <addr>, <addr>): 2 of 2 restarts changed the address
S24.timer_rotation: none; <addr> was on air  to  (1014 s, 16.9 min) unchanged

results.note: ASUS app log and A15s app log showed S24 and M31 with the same RPA values; ASUS app log alone showed S24 identity address <addr> because ASUS is bonded to S24 and Android resolves the RPA for bonded peers.

method: Manual measurement session (not a runner suite, no generated media input). Address and identifier values, raw logs and controller captures are not published; counts and timings are.
